poles.label: The recipe has headroom
poles.claim: Scaling, RL, and inference-time reasoning keep delivering; no new ingredient required yet.

poles.label: A new ingredient is needed
poles.claim: Continual, on-the-job learning (or another missing capability) gates further progress.

poles.label: Horizons are accelerating
poles.claim: The doubling time itself has shortened; the curve broke upward in 2025.

poles.label: Headline numbers overstate
poles.claim: Reliability-adjusted horizons are far shorter, and benchmarks embed human scaffolding.

poles.label: Direct automation capability is rising
poles.claim: End-to-end automation of real projects is improving fast on direct measures — a fact about what models can do, not yet about employment.

poles.label: Reorganization without aggregate decline
poles.claim: Exposure and adoption predict restructured work and shifted hiring, not employment loss — so far.

poles.label: How to read the evidence
poles.claim: What the benchmarks, exposure measures, and usage data capture — and what they cannot.

poles.label: Policy and institutional responses
poles.claim: Proposals and positions from institutions, included for what they reveal as much as what they argue.

poles.label: AI is the driver
poles.claim: Entry-level contraction in exposed occupations is real and attributable to AI.

poles.label: Other causes, small effects
poles.claim: Rates, remote work, and macro conditions explain most of it; aggregate effects remain small.

poles.label: Controls bought real time
poles.claim: Compute denial slowed the frontier race and remains worth its costs.

poles.label: Substitution is accelerating
poles.claim: China is building a parallel stack; the controls' premises have aged.

poles.label: Tracking the ground truth
poles.claim: Compute stocks and shifting policy, measured.

poles.label: Concentration is the danger
poles.claim: Unchecked control of frontier AI is a systemic, possibly irreversible risk.

poles.label: Accountability over dispersal
poles.claim: What matters is power answering to competing institutions, not power being small.

poles.label: Displacement and harm signals
poles.claim: Longitudinal and youth data point to dependency and relationships not formed.

poles.label: Depends on design and rules
poles.claim: The outcome is contingent on how asymmetric intimacy is built and governed.
